purpose: Canonical evidence shard for LORE Crypto History. Card scoring is intentionally deferred until research and deduplication are complete.

events.title: Tesla discloses a $1.5 billion Bitcoin purchase
events.summary: Tesla disclosed in its 2020 Form 10-K that it had invested an aggregate $1.5 billion in bitcoin after updating its investment policy in January 2021.
events.significance: One of the world's most prominent public companies put Bitcoin directly on its balance sheet, accelerating the corporate-treasury narrative.

events.title: Beeple's Everydays sells for $69.3 million
events.summary: Christie's sold Beeple's Everydays: The First 5000 Days for $69,346,250 in an online auction.
events.significance: The sale made NFTs a mainstream global art-market story and set a record for digital art at the time.

events.title: Coinbase completes its Nasdaq direct listing
events.summary: Coinbase Global completed the direct listing of its Class A common stock on Nasdaq on 14 April 2021.
events.significance: The listing brought one of crypto's largest exchanges directly into US public equity markets.

events.title: Bored Ape Yacht Club launches
events.summary: Bored Ape Yacht Club released its 10,000-piece collection on 23 April 2021.
events.significance: BAYC became one of the defining NFT brands of the 2021 boom and helped turn PFP collections into membership, identity and IP ecosystems.

sources.title: BAYC — The Birth of the Bored Ape Yacht Club

events.title: Uniswap v3 launches with concentrated liquidity
events.summary: Uniswap v3 deployed to Ethereum mainnet on 5 May 2021 with concentrated liquidity and other market-making changes.
events.significance: V3 materially changed automated-market-maker capital efficiency and became major DeFi trading infrastructure.

events.title: Dogecoin mania peaks around Elon Musk's Saturday Night Live appearance
events.summary: Dogecoin entered the weekend of Elon Musk's 8 May 2021 Saturday Night Live appearance after an extraordinary run; Reuters reported it had risen more than 800% in the preceding month and reached an approximately $81 billion market capitalization.
events.significance: The episode made meme coins a mainstream market category and showed how social media, celebrity attention and internet culture could move crypto markets at enormous scale.

sources.title: Reuters — Dogecoin in spotlight as Musk makes SNL appearance

events.notes: Treat the SNL appearance as the cultural focal point, not as proof that it alone caused Dogecoin's price move.

events.title: El Salvador's legislature approves the Bitcoin Law
events.summary: El Salvador's Legislative Assembly approved Decree No. 57, the Bitcoin Law, in June 2021, establishing the legal framework for Bitcoin as legal tender.
events.significance: El Salvador became the first sovereign state to legislate Bitcoin as legal tender.

sources.title: El Salvador Legislative Assembly — Bitcoin Law, Decree No. 57

events.title: Uniswap v3 launches on Optimism
events.summary: Uniswap announced the alpha launch of v3 on Optimistic Ethereum mainnet on 13 July 2021.
events.significance: It was an early high-profile demonstration of major DeFi activity moving onto optimistic rollup infrastructure.

events.title: Ethereum London activates EIP-1559
events.summary: Ethereum activated the London upgrade at block 12,965,000, introducing EIP-1559's base-fee mechanism and fee burning.
events.significance: EIP-1559 fundamentally redesigned Ethereum's transaction-fee market and introduced a mechanism that burns part of transaction fees.

events.title: Poly Network suffers a $612 million cross-chain exploit
events.summary: An attacker exploited Poly Network and stole about $612 million across multiple chains.
events.significance: It was then the largest DeFi theft, and its aftermath became uniquely strange when the attacker returned nearly all of the funds.

events.title: Poly Network attacker returns most stolen funds
events.summary: Within days of the exploit, the Poly Network attacker began returning stolen crypto and communicated using on-chain transaction messages.
events.significance: The 'Mr White Hat' return saga became one of crypto's strangest hack stories and a classic example of on-chain negotiation.

sources.title: Chainalysis — Poly Network attacker returning funds

events.title: Visa buys a CryptoPunk
events.summary: Visa purchased CryptoPunk #7610 for 49.5 ETH, approximately $150,000 at the time.
events.significance: A global payments company purchasing an NFT symbolized institutional curiosity around digital collectibles.

events.title: OpenSea volume explodes during NFT summer
events.summary: OpenSea and the broader NFT secondary market experienced an enormous trading surge during August 2021; OpenSea later described August as the first NFT boom peak.
events.significance: The month captured the moment NFTs became a large liquid consumer market rather than a niche collector subculture.

sources.title: OpenSea — Why We Don't Mind the Dips

events.title: El Salvador's Bitcoin Law takes effect
events.summary: El Salvador's Bitcoin Law entered into force in September 2021, making Bitcoin legal tender alongside the US dollar under the law then in effect.
events.significance: This was the first implementation of national Bitcoin legal-tender status.

sources.title: El Salvador Legislative Assembly — Bitcoin Law

events.title: Solana suffers a major network outage
events.summary: Solana went offline for roughly 17 hours after transaction flooding during a Raydium IDO caused memory pressure, validator crashes and loss of consensus; validators coordinated a network restart.
events.significance: The outage became an important counterpoint to Solana's high-throughput design and a recurring part of debates over blockchain liveness, validator coordination and decentralization.

sources.title: Solana Foundation — 9-14 Network Outage Initial Overview

events.notes: Add official Solana incident report before upgrading to VERIFIED.

events.title: China orders a comprehensive crackdown on crypto mining
events.summary: China's National Development and Reform Commission and other authorities published a nationwide notice calling for strict control of new cryptocurrency-mining projects and an orderly phase-out of existing activity.
events.significance: The crackdown accelerated one of the largest geographic migrations of Bitcoin mining capacity in the network's history.

sources.title: NDRC — Notice on rectifying virtual-currency mining

events.title: China declares crypto-related business activities illegal financial activity
events.summary: The People's Bank of China and other agencies stated that virtual-currency-related business activities constituted illegal financial activity and extended restrictions to overseas exchanges serving Chinese residents.
events.significance: The notice was the strongest nationwide Chinese restriction on crypto trading and services to that date.

sources.title: PBOC — Notice on virtual-currency trading risks

events.title: Ethereum Beacon Chain activates Altair
events.summary: Altair activated at epoch 74,240, becoming the first scheduled upgrade of Ethereum's Beacon Chain.
events.significance: Altair added sync committees and strengthened validator penalties while preparing the consensus layer for the Merge.

events.title: Facebook renames itself Meta amid metaverse mania
events.summary: Facebook announced that its corporate brand would become Meta and explicitly framed the company's future around building the metaverse.
events.significance: The rebrand pushed 'metaverse' from crypto and gaming subcultures into global mainstream technology conversation and accelerated speculative interest in metaverse-linked tokens and NFTs.

sources.title: Meta — Introducing Meta: A Social Technology Company

events.notes: Add Meta newsroom primary source before verification.

events.title: ENS governance token airdrop begins
events.summary: ENS distributed governance tokens to eligible holders of ENS names based on a 31 October snapshot, with claiming opening in early November 2021.
events.significance: The airdrop became a landmark retroactive distribution rewarding protocol users and converting an identity service into a DAO-governed ecosystem.

events.title: Bitcoin Taproot activates
events.summary: Taproot's new Bitcoin consensus rules activated at block 709,632 after locking in through the Speedy Trial activation process.
events.significance: Taproot introduced Schnorr signatures and more flexible, private and efficient complex spending conditions, laying groundwork for future Bitcoin scripting development.

events.title: ConstitutionDAO loses the Sotheby's auction after raising tens of millions
events.summary: ConstitutionDAO raised roughly $47 million from thousands of contributors to bid for a rare first printing of the US Constitution but lost the Sotheby's auction; the document sold for $43.2 million.
events.significance: The experiment became one of the clearest mainstream demonstrations of internet-native DAO coordination, crowdfunding and its limitations.

events.title: Ronin launches to scale Axie Infinity
events.summary: Sky Mavis launched Ronin in 2021 as a dedicated blockchain for Axie Infinity.
events.significance: Ronin enabled Axie to onboard millions of users and became one of the most important gaming-specific crypto networks before its 2022 bridge exploit.

events.title: Axie Infinity play-to-earn and scholarship economy explodes
events.summary: Axie Infinity grew to millions of players in 2021, while scholarship arrangements let asset owners lend NFT teams to players in exchange for shared earnings.
events.significance: Axie turned play-to-earn into a global crypto labor/economic phenomenon, especially in emerging markets.

events.title: Optimism deploys OP Mainnet
events.summary: Optimism deployed OP Mainnet in January 2021 as one of the first major optimistic rollups operating in production.
events.significance: The launch was an early milestone in Ethereum's rollup-centric scaling era.

events.title: Optimism removes its deployment whitelist
events.summary: Optimism opened OP Mainnet to permissionless application deployment in December 2021.
events.significance: The change turned the early production rollup into an open application platform.

events.title: Arbitrum One opens to users
events.summary: Offchain Labs opened Arbitrum One to the public on 31 August 2021 after an earlier developer-access phase.
events.significance: Arbitrum One became one of Ethereum's most important optimistic-rollup networks and a major milestone in the shift of Ethereum activity toward Layer 2 scaling.
events.notes: Add Offchain Labs launch announcement before verification.

events.title: NFT profile-picture culture becomes a mainstream crypto identity phenomenon
events.summary: CryptoPunks, BAYC and a wave of avatar collections turned NFTs into social identity, status and online community membership during 2021.
events.significance: PFP culture moved NFT ownership from collecting into visible internet identity and community signaling.

events.title: NFT secondary trading peaks during the first NFT boom
events.summary: OpenSea later described August 2021 as the peak of the first NFT boom, with billions of dollars of monthly secondary sales across the market.
events.significance: The boom transformed NFTs into one of crypto's largest consumer-market categories.

events.title: Terra, UST and Anchor expand rapidly around high stablecoin yields
events.summary: Anchor launched in March 2021 and promoted a near-20% UST deposit yield. By late 2021, Anchor had become central to Terra's growth and UST demand, with community discussions already focused on sustaining the yield reserve.
events.significance: The 2021 expansion created the economic structure that would become central to Terra's extraordinary rise and its 2022 collapse.

sources.title: Anchor Forum — Increasing the Yield Reserve

events.notes: Era/context node rather than one discrete card event; likely connects to later UST/LUNA collapse cards.

events.title: OlympusDAO turns '(3,3)' into DeFi culture
events.summary: OlympusDAO's staking and bonding culture popularized the '(3,3)' game-theory meme across DeFi communities in 2021, while Olympus Pro extended the protocol-owned-liquidity model to other projects.
events.significance: The meme became shorthand for cooperative staking behavior and one of the most recognizable cultural artifacts of the DeFi 2.0 era.
events.notes: Culture/context candidate. Score only if we deliberately want a DeFi meme/culture card.

events.title: Solana ecosystem booms
events.summary: Solana Foundation's year-end figures show growth from roughly $100 million TVL, 360 validators and 70 projects in January to $11.4 billion TVL, 1,328 validators and 5,145 projects by December 2021.
events.significance: 2021 established Solana as a major non-Ethereum smart-contract ecosystem spanning DeFi, NFTs and consumer applications.
events.notes: Era node; discrete Solana events such as the outage may be stronger physical-card candidates.

events.title: Bitcoin mining hash rate migrates after China's crackdown
events.summary: After China's mining restrictions, large amounts of Bitcoin mining capacity relocated to other jurisdictions, including the United States and Kazakhstan.
events.significance: The migration materially changed Bitcoin mining geography and reduced China's once-dominant share of global hash rate.

events.title: Tesla suspends Bitcoin vehicle payments over environmental concerns
events.summary: Tesla suspended Bitcoin vehicle purchases in May 2021; its SEC filing later confirmed the suspension, while Elon Musk publicly cited concern over fossil-fuel use in Bitcoin mining and transactions.
events.significance: The reversal pushed Bitcoin's energy consumption into mainstream corporate and political debate and triggered a sharp market reaction.

sources.title: Reuters — Tesla suspends Bitcoin car payments

events.title: Bitcoin reaches its 2021 cycle high near $69,000
events.summary: Bitcoin reached a new all-time high near $69,000 on 10 November 2021 before reversing lower; exact prints vary by exchange and index.
events.significance: The high marked the culmination of the 2020-2021 bull cycle and became the reference peak against which the 2022 crash was measured.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Bitcoin pulls back from all-time high

events.notes: Use source-specific price when publishing; there was no single universal spot price.

events.title: Web3 enters mainstream technology vocabulary
events.summary: The term 'Web3' spread well beyond crypto-native communities during 2021 as venture capital, NFTs, DAOs and metaverse narratives gained mainstream attention.
events.significance: This is useful era context but is too diffuse to treat as one canonical event without a defined publication, trend metric or institutional milestone.
events.notes: Do not score as a card in this form. Replace with a discrete Web3 milestone if one is selected.

note: 2021 canonical evidence pass tightened. Broad context nodes are explicitly separated from discrete verified events; low-confidence candidates are held from scoring.
